newsitem.title: USA: Aon completes sale of preferred securities.
newsitem.headline: Aon completes sale of preferred securities.

text.p: Aon Corp said Tuesday that it has completed, through a subsidiary, the sale of $800 million of preferred Capital Securities.
The proceeds will be used to finance, in part, the pending acquisition of Alexander & Alexander Services Inc, the company said.
Aon also said all regulatory approval, including that of the New York Insurance Department, relating to the pending tender offer for shares of A&A common stock have been obtained.
The tender offer is being made under a December 11, 1996 merger plan, which was valued at $1.23 billion.
Aon is a holding company offering insurance brokerage, consulting and consumer insurance services. A&A, based in New York, provides insurance and human resources services.
